robot_body.label: Robot Body
command:
set -e
source ~/echo_runtime/bin/echo_env.sh
LOG_DIR=~/echo_runtime/logs
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
ESP32_PORT="/dev/serial/by-path/platform-xhci-hcd.1-usb-0:1:1.0-port0"
ESP32_BAUD="115200"

pkill -x micro_ros_agent 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1

echo "[robot_body] starting micro_ros_agent on $ESP32_PORT @ $ESP32_BAUD"
ros2 run micro_ros_agent micro_ros_agent serial --dev "$ESP32_PORT" -b "$ESP32_BAUD" -v4 > "$LOG_DIR/robot_body_micro_ros_agent.log" 2>&1 &
AGENT_PID=$!

echo "[robot_body] agent pid=$AGENT_PID"
echo "[robot_body] if ESP32 topics do not appear, press ESP32 RST and retry Robot Body"

trap 'kill "$AGENT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$AGENT_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
wait "$AGENT_PID"

localization.label: Localization
command:
set -e
source ~/echo_runtime/bin/echo_env.sh
LOG_DIR=~/echo_runtime/logs; mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
YDLIDAR_SRC="$HOME/.openclaw/workspace/github_echo/echo_workspace/src/ydlidar_ros2_driver"; YDLIDAR_PARAMS="$YDLIDAR_SRC/params/ydlidar.yaml"
bash -lc "ros2 launch '$YDLIDAR_SRC/launch/ydlidar_launch.py' params_file:='$YDLIDAR_PARAMS'" > "$LOG_DIR/localization_ydlidar.log" 2>&1 & P1=$!
bash -lc "ros2 run robot_controller esp32_encoder_odometry" > "$LOG_DIR/localization_odom.log" 2>&1 & P2=$!
bash -lc "ros2 launch echo_bringup ekf_launch.py" > "$LOG_DIR/localization_ekf.log" 2>&1 & P3=$!
trap 'kill "$P1" "$P2" "$P3" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$P1" "$P2" "$P3" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
for t in /scan /wheel_odom /odometry/filtered; do end=$((SECONDS+30)); f=0; while [ "$SECONDS" -lt "$end" ]; do ros2 topic list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$t" && f=1 && break; sleep 1; done; [ "$f" -eq 1 ] || exit 1; done
wait

navigation.label: Navigation
command:
set -e
source ~/echo_runtime/bin/echo_env.sh

safe_kill() {
  pattern="$1"
  for pid in $(pgrep -f "$pattern" 2>/dev/null || true); do
    [ "$pid" = "$$" ] && continue
    [ "$pid" = "$BASHPID" ] && continue
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
}

cd ~/.openclaw/workspace/github_echo/echo_workspace

LOG_DIR=~/echo_runtime/logs
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

echo "[navigation] stopping mapping/navigation leftovers before navigation..."

safe_kill "[m]apping_launch.py"
safe_kill "[s]lam_toolbox"


safe_kill "[a]utonomous_navigation_launch.py"
safe_kill "[n]av2_bringup.*bringup_launch.py"
safe_kill "[c]omponent_container.*nav2_container"
safe_kill "[c]omponent_container_isolated.*nav2_container"
safe_kill "[a]priltag_action_router.py"


safe_kill "[m]icro_ros_agent.*serial"
safe_kill "[e]sp32_encoder_odometry"
safe_kill "[e]kf_node"
safe_kill "[y]dlidar_ros2_driver_node"
safe_kill "[s]tatic_transform_publisher.*laser_frame"
safe_kill "[j]oint_state_publisher"
safe_kill "[r]obot_state_publisher"


echo "[navigation] starting real autonomous navigation launch..."
exec ros2 launch echo_bringup autonomous_navigation_launch.py

camera.label: Camera
command:
set -e
source ~/echo_runtime/bin/echo_env.sh

LOG_DIR=~/echo_runtime/logs
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

echo "[camera] starting camera publisher on index 8"
python3 $HOME/.openclaw/workspace/github_echo/echo_workspace/src/echo_perception/scripts/camera_publisher.py \
  --ros-args \
  -p camera_index:=8 \
  -p width:=640 \
  -p height:=480 \
  -p fps:=15.0 \
  > "$LOG_DIR/camera_publisher.log" 2>&1 &
CAMERA_PID=$!

sleep 3

echo "[camera] starting apriltag detector"
python3 $HOME/.openclaw/workspace/github_echo/echo_workspace/src/echo_perception/scripts/apriltag_detector.py \
  > "$LOG_DIR/apriltag_detector.log" 2>&1 &
APRILTAG_PID=$!

cleanup() {
  echo "[camera] stopping camera pipeline"
  kill "$CAMERA_PID" "$APRILTAG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  wait "$CAMERA_PID" "$APRILTAG_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

echo "[camera] pipeline online"
echo "[camera] dashboard topic: /apriltag/annotated_image/compressed"

wait
